items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: Because he used to like to talk to me about my father. He used to like to talk about, he said, Aaron was a fine man.

ctx.x: How long did you usually run? An hour?

One hour. One hour. One hour. But I was smart though. I used to always go on Wednesday nights when there wouldn't be many scholars there. I'd get a little bit more. Because he used to like to talk to me about my father. He used to like to talk about, he said, Aaron was a fine man. He said, boy if you ever make the musician he was you'll be alright. He said, fine musician. He used to talk about him all the time. And I used to tell him all the time, I said, well first I didn't know him. I didn't want to see his…
Well he played in the bands too at times. One more thing before I forget it. In teaching you to count, what did he do? Did he make you count with your foot or that?
